_doc: Source of truth for GUI skin glyphs. Font key sovereignmc:gui_skins. Spaces font sovereignmc:spaces: codepoint 0xD0000+n advances n px (n in -8192..8192). Chest title origin (8,6), anvil title origin (60,6). A bitmap glyph with ascent A has its top at window y = 13 - A. Bitmap advance = width + 1. Decor 'label' draws in bayInk (for dark bays) unless tone='ink' (for the light chassis); guide skin always uses ink. tabtrack may carry c0..c1 to limit the strip to those columns (default whole row).

grid_legend.P: pin socket (socket + dashed gold outline + faint pin)

geometry.cell: socket frame top-left = (7+col*18, 17+row*18), 18x18; item drawn at +1,+1
geometry.lcd_segments: baked off-segments 3x6 at x = lcdX+10, step 4, while x < lcdX+w-3, y = lcdY+4; baked off-lamp 4x4 at (lcdX+3, lcdY+5)
geometry.digits: 3x10 glyphs (3x5 font, rows doubled), centred: x = lcdX + floor((w - (len*4-1))/2), y = lcdY+3

overlays.colour: lcdOn (steel/admin) ; guide skin uses its own lcdOn

emblems._doc: Structure logos reused from SovereignPlates. Source: assets/sovereignmc/textures/font/plate/struct_<family>.png (32x48; the logo is the top 32x32, 16x16 pixel art at 2x). Emblem glyph = that 32x32 copied unchanged. Drawn on guide_structure at window (9,37): ascent = 13-37 = -24, height 32, advance 33. Plaque decor 'emblem' = cells c0..c1 x r0..r1 (window 7..43 x 35..71): leather fill (guide.leather) with a 1px leatherLo outer line, 1px leatherHi inner bevel, and an accent (guide #a0442c) corner tick on each corner; no sockets.

item_icons._doc: Same logos as 16x16 item icons for guide structure items: downscale the 32x32 logo by taking the top-left pixel of each 2x2 block (pixel-exact). Write textures/item/guide/struct_<family>.png, models/item/guide/struct_<family>.json ({"parent":"minecraft:item/generated","textures":{"layer0":"sovereignmc:item/guide/struct_<family>"}}) and items/guide/struct_<family>.json ({"model":{"type":"minecraft:model","model":"sovereignmc:item/guide/struct_<family>"}}). Plugin sets item_model sovereignmc:guide/struct_<family>.
item_icons.family_from_type_key: strip a trailing _T<digits>, lowercase; ENCHANTMENT_CENTRIFUGE -> enchant_centrifuge, MUNITIONS_FACTORY -> munitions; anything not in families -> no logo

chapter_tiles._doc: decor 'chapters' on guide_home: for chapter i (0..5) tile = cells cols (i%3)*3..+2, rows 1+(i//3)*2..+1; tile rect x=cx(c0)+1,y=cy(r0)+1,w=52,h=34: bevel('#ecdfb9','#fbf3dc','#9b814d'); 20x20 leather inset plate at (x+16,y+2) with the chapter icon (control art) at (x+18,y+4) 1x; label in guide ink centred at y+25; 1px accent rule at y+h-3 from x+3 to x+w-4. Copy the look of the GSCREENS 'Structures Guide' draw() in the controls proposal page.

controls._doc: Control icons, 16x16, art ported from the controls proposal page (ART/COL/TIERS DSL in /tmp/claude-1000/-home-rattly-compiles-sovereignmc/7251c3db-1621-423a-9d90-2698bc9622c1/scratchpad/gui-controls/index.src.html). Item model key sovereignmc:ui/<id>. Textures textures/item/ui/<id>.png (single state) or <id>_<n>.png; models models/item/ui/<id>[_<n>].json parent minecraft:item/generated. Item definition items/ui/<id>.json: single state -> plain minecraft:model; multi-state -> minecraft:range_dispatch on minecraft:custom_model_data index 0 with thresholds 1..n-1 and fallback = state 0. 'blank' is a fully transparent 16x16 (invisible hotspot). State meaning: page_prev/page_next 0 enabled,1 disabled(grey); charge 0..4 = fill level; crate 0 linked,1 linking,2 none/broken; run 0 running,1 paused; pin 0 pinned,1 unpinned; layer_up/down 0 enabled,1 disabled(grey).
